title: Pixel Art Quiz
description: 16×16 pixel art quiz. Students select colours by typing their binary value and vote on each other's artwork.

steps.title: Pixel Art Quiz
steps.content:
Pixel Art Quiz

In this quiz you will create a 16×16 pixel art drawing. To select a colour you must type its 4-bit binary number — use the calculator and colour chart on the right to help you work out which binary number to type.

Your teacher must connect Google Drive before this quiz can start.

quizQuestions.q: Create a pixel art drawing of your favourite animal! 🐾
Draw a pixel art portrait of yourself! 🧑‍🎨
Draw your favourite food or drink in pixel art! 🍕
Create a pixel art scene of your dream house! 🏠
Draw a pixel art landscape — could be a beach, mountain, city or anything you like! 🌄
Create a pixel art character for a video game — hero, villain or anything in between! 🎮
Draw a pixel art spaceship or alien planet! 🚀
Create pixel art of your favourite sport or hobby! ⚽
Free draw — create anything you like in pixel art! 🎨
Draw a pixel art map of an imaginary place — give it features, landmarks and a name! 🗺️
Create a pixel art logo for an imaginary company or game! 🏷️
Draw a pixel art monster or mythical creature of your own invention! 👾
